import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Load member data
members_df = pd.read_csv('csv/member.csv')

# Connect to attendance database
conn = sqlite3.connect('db/attendance.db')
attendance_df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT link_to_event, link_to_member FROM attendance", conn)
conn.close()

# Filter for Women's Soccer event
women_soccer_id = 'rec2N69DMcrqN9PJC'
soccer_attendees = attendance_df[attendance_df['link_to_event'] == women_soccer_id]['link_to_member']

# Join with members and filter for Medium t-shirt size
result = members_df[members_df['member_id'].isin(soccer_attendees)]
medium_count = len(result[result['t_shirt_size'] == 'Medium'])

print(medium_count)
